body:
Amendment A2 on STORY-1706: one added fail-closed condition (no live process with AIDA_RELAY_RUN=<run> may remain; an orphan agent session of a kill -9 crash would otherwise run beside the restart).
Also flagged: the signed spec-known floor makes most real runs refuse (relay.status ticket= is the slot path). A1 + A2 await your ruling; PR B code is written but cannot compile (disk floor).
subject: STORY-1706 amendment A2 (orphan-session check) + spec-known limit
